sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Genjutsu (Tactile), Fuinjutsu, Yin Release

system.description:
(As a part of the casting of this Jutsu you must have the Miraigan active.) By focusing your Yin Chakra, you are able to break the instinctual connection of time on a cellular level.

Make a melee ninjutsu attack, dealing 6d10 Necrotic damage and forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creatures is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creature is unable to regain hit points until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creature is unable to regain hit points or chakra points, until the end of your next turn as their cells fail to replicate.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they also cannot maintain concentration on jutsu until the end of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d10.
